newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Fire engine kills three in central Philippines.
newsitem.headline: Fire engine kills three in central Philippines.

text.p: A fire engine speeding to an emergency call on Thursday spun out of control and killed three bystanders who had gathered to watch the blaze, police in the central Philippines said.
Two other people were injured in the incident in Bacolod city, some 500 km (310 miles) south of Manila, police said. No one was injured in the blaze, which damaged a small store.
Police said the fire engine driver had been detained for questioning.
